newsitem.title: USA: Moyco settles with government for $505,000.
newsitem.headline: Moyco settles with government for $505,000.

text.p: Moyco Technologies Inc said Wednesday it agreed to pay $505,000 over four years to the U.S. government to resolve all civil liability regarding government contracts for the manufacturing of foot powder.

The company said the settlement with U.S. Attorney for the eastern Distict of Pennsylvania is in addition to the $175,000 fine Moyco paid when it pled guilty in April to federal criminal charges that it failed to maintain quality-control procedures for footpowder it sold the U.S. government.
The company's stock traded unchanged at 7-7/8 Wednesday.
